name: fresh-idle-120x40

name: draft-reply-ok-120x40
box_text: reply with the single word ok
description: Full prompt typed into the box, not yet submitted (Enter not pressed).

name: idle-after-turn-120x40
description: Idle again after one completed turn; no dim suggestion reappeared here.

name: vim-normal-120x40
description: Esc pressed on an empty box: vim NORMAL mode. Claude Code draws no '-- NORMAL --' marker; the only on-screen difference from vim being off is that the row is still actively repainted by the same footer component (see README).

name: vim-insert-120x40
description: 'i' pressed after Esc: vim INSERT mode, '-- INSERT --' marker shown.

name: draft-hello-120x40
description: 'hello draft' typed while in vim INSERT mode, not submitted.

name: busy-generating-120x40
description: 2-3s into a long streamed reply. The box itself is empty throughout generation -- busy detection is out of scope for input_box and is handled elsewhere (session status, output-quiet timing).

name: interrupted-normal-120x40
description: Esc interrupted the streamed reply. Esc also drops vim into NORMAL mode as a side effect (no INSERT marker afterwards).

name: ask-user-question-dialog-120x40
description: AskUserQuestion dialog. Row 12 starts with '❯ 1. Red' (a list cursor, not the input box) and has no rule row directly above it -- row 11 is blank, not '─'.

name: after-esc-ask-user-question-120x40
description: Esc cancelled the AskUserQuestion dialog; back to the empty main box.

name: permission-prompt-dialog-120x40
description: Write-tool approval dialog ('Do you want to create perm-probe.txt?'). Row 18 starts with '❯ 1. Yes' (a list cursor), no rule row directly above it.

name: after-esc-permission-prompt-120x40
description: Esc declined the Write-tool permission prompt; back to the empty main box. No file was created.

name: compact-menu-typed-120x40
description: '/compact' typed (command menu open above the box), not yet submitted. box_text is exactly '/compact' -- no trailing space or other autocomplete artifact.

name: compact-started-120x40
description: Right after Enter: the box is cleared and 'Compacting conversation…' is shown above it. Enter ran the typed '/compact' (it was also the top-ranked/highlighted menu entry, so this single trial can't fully separate the two, but the verified outcome -- compaction starts, no stray text lands in the box -- is what step 6 needs).

name: compact-in-progress-120x40
description: ~7s into compaction, still in progress ('Compacting conversation… (7s · ↓ 91 tokens)').

name: compact-finished-120x40
description: Compaction finished (~24s in): context usage reset to 0/167k, the 'Compacting…' spinner is gone, box empty and idle again.

name: model-picker-dialog-120x40
description: /model picker. Row 27 starts with '❯ 5. Haiku 4.5 ✔' (a list cursor); its top border (row 18) is drawn with '▔' (U+2594), not '─', so it would fail the rule-row check even before reaching the missing-rule-directly-above check.

name: after-esc-model-picker-120x40
description: Esc cancelled the /model picker; back to the empty main box.

name: after-esc-history-search-120x40
description: Back to idle after Esc-cancelling a Ctrl-R history search. The history-search overlay itself is not shipped as a fixture: with search scope 'everywhere' it rendered real unrelated prompt text from the operator's actual usage history, which cannot be safely redacted to a known-word list. The '❯ used as a list cursor inside an overlay' trap is already covered by the AskUserQuestion, permission-prompt and /model-picker fixtures above.

name: draft-paste-placeholder-120x40

name: busy-streaming-title-only-120x40
